summary: Tests-only (red-phase) run for issue #39. Committed: (1) SolverParityCorpusTests — loads the solver-parity corpus from ColorComposerCore/Tests/ColorComposerCoreTests/Fixtures/solver_parity_corpus.json (vendored from viamin/color_matching#111) and asserts exact WeightedSquaredErrorScorer/CompositionSolver selections vs the Elixir corpus, including ties (earliest palette-order wins), exclusions, expected scores, and weight handling; corpus fixture intentionally absent, so testCorpusIsCommittedAtTheCanonicalLocation and testEveryCorpusCaseMatchesTheElixirSelectionExactly are red by design until the implementation run vendors it; harness self-check testHarnessVerifiesTheDocumentedReferenceCase (Elixir doctest vector, score 0.205) exercises the identical verification path. (2) PaletteAPIClientContractTests — pins PaletteAPIClient's observable contract (/api/v1 request shapes, Accept/Bearer headers, 401->unauthorized / 503->badStatus / undecodable->malformedResponse, full snake_case wire envelopes incl. raw_value/raw_unit/apparent_brightness/measured_at/test_run_id) as the safety net for the swift-openapi-generator migration. (3) OfflineFallbackCacheTests — fetch->cache->failed-refetch->cached-served flow (per (server, profile) keying, fetchedAt preserved for offline-stale badging, cached-profile picker fallback). (4) docs/solver-parity-corpus.md (corpus location, format, refresh) and docs/openapi-client-migration-notes.md (criterion mapping, /api/v1 shape pins, PR-description templates). No Swift toolchain exists in this container: swift is not installed and bin/lint exits 0 with its documented skip notice, so swift test could not be executed here; the suite must be run on a macOS host (cd ColorComposerCore && swift test). All changes are confined to the test path ColorComposerCore/Tests/ColorComposerCoreTests/ and the docs/ allowlist; no implementation files were touched.
